# All Yono India

> All Yono India (allyonoindia.com) is an independent India-specific verification hub for All Yono-branded games. It tracks and clearly labels what is actually known, for users in India specifically, about availability, legal status, UPI support, and KYC, alongside a directory of Yono-branded apps with their currently listed download links and promo code status. It is not affiliated with YONO SBI, the State Bank of India, or any game developer. Game names and icons are shown for identification only.

Content is for adults (18+). Online money games are prohibited in India under the Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025, in force with the Online Gaming Rules, 2026 since 1 May 2026; the legal guide below links to the official MeitY and PIB sources. Some download links are referral links and are disclosed on each page. The site does not require an account, does not host APK files itself, and never collects OTPs, passwords, or payment details. Missing India-specific data is always labeled "Not Yet Reviewed", never treated as a negative fact.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://allyonoindia.com/): Directory overview and featured games.
- [India Guide](https://allyonoindia.com/india-guide/): How India-specific facts (availability, legal status, UPI, KYC) are verified and labeled.
- [All Yono Games](https://allyonoindia.com/all-yono-games/): Full directory with download links, access notes, and an India-Specific Status panel on each game page.
- [Promo Code](https://allyonoindia.com/promo-code/): Morning, afternoon, and evening promo code status per game, with the date the data was last changed.
- [Blog](https://allyonoindia.com/blog/): Guides and access notes.
